title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
让藤藤蛇去一旁练习青草搅拌器的双重形态...林枫从储物球里面拿出了凳子，拿起手机刷了起来。他可不是在偷懒，而是在找收购种植物的商贩。种植园里面少数收获，林枫会保存起来，配合着其它的今年的桃桃果和橙橙果制造成为解毒能量方块和体力能量方块。这样易于保存，也能当作培育屋里面的商品。再送一点给秦爷爷。其余的，会全部卖出去。至于渠道...林枫并不担心。因为当年父母去过不少收购蔬菜和农作物的地方。其中最有名的一家地方叫做喇叭芽果蔬百货超市，现在一扫，名字竟然已经变成了大食花食品有限公司。看样子，十年的时间，它也进化了....“就这家了...”....大食花食品有限公司—老板办公室。老板陈萧最近有些愁，刚上市的大食花食品有限公司，就遇上了第一个难题。那就是“同行”的挤压。准确的来说。不是同行，而是只沾上一点边缘的超市。不过...人家是梧桐市的最大公司——旺旺有限公司。在大食花还是果蔬超市的时候，对方就有些打压的趋势了。这种趋势，在大食花食品有限公司上市后，就变得明目张胆了起来。首先是超市内有关于果蔬的食品区大降价。然后是从源头上高价截取他们的收货渠道。如此这般，公司下面的各个果蔬市场以及超市，东西卖不出去的同时，新鲜的食品原材料也收不回来。一来二往下去，公司迟早倒闭。所以，现在的问题是，急需一个稳定的供货商。“怎么了？还在为超市的事情头疼吗？”就在他扶额的时候，

一个穿着黄色花纹裙子的美妇从外面走了进来，女人身姿丰腴婀娜，扎着马尾，容貌艳丽。陈萧叹了一声气，看着眼前的妻子，摇了摇头，最终还是没说什么。老夫少妻，再加上一个正在读高中的女儿。眼下都正是需要消耗精力的时刻，他才四十来岁，就已经大把大把的掉头发了。“没办法，旺旺超市的打压太狠了，没有号的供货渠道，公司可能刚上市就要被打下去了。”陈萧最终还是没有和自己的妻子隐瞒情况。“那我们就开回小超市嘛，月儿的宝可梦也不一定非要准神，我们挑一个很不错的御三家也行呀。”“如果挑了准神宝可梦，后续还需要一大笔钱培养，万一以后出了什么事故，培养不起来，准神宝可梦也是糟蹋了....”女人看着愁绪满满的老公，不由得劝说道。“话是这么说...可是孩子...”话到一般，陈萧又叹了一口气。人家是全国连锁的大公司，自己只是梧桐镇的小产业，在资金链上，怎么可能比得上对方？唯一可能赢的办法，就是在品质上胜过对方的果蔬。还要是碾压似的胜过对方。可是...想要种出这样的果蔬，代表着，起码得是培育家出手。还要是专精种植这方面的培育家。可培育家本就稀缺，更别说专精种植方面的培育家了。“哎...不行的话...”他也确实觉得是自己多想了，正打算放弃。桌子上面的座机突然响起。“洛托，采购部部门来电，是否接听？”“采购部？”陈萧一愣，随后立马拿起洛托姆牌座机，“是我，怎么了？”“嗯？有新的供货渠道？样品看起来很好？在...好的，我知道了。”他放下座机，虽然刚刚听到了有新的供货渠道，但表情却仍然没有好转。“怎么了？不是说有新的供货渠道嘛？这不是应该高兴的事情嘛？”旁边的妻子见到老公没有高兴起来的表情，不由得询问道。陈萧苦笑道：“是有新的供货渠道，但是是梧桐镇的那个种植园，那个种植园，你也知道，是以前老林家的，现在听说被他孩子接手了...”“你想想，一个孩子，能种多少东西？而且，质量还不一定好呢。”妻子有些惊愕的道：“小枫那孩子？他不去读高中，继承家里的种植园？”喜欢宝可梦：开局一只美纳斯和君主蛇请大家收藏：（aiquwx）宝可梦：开局一只美纳斯和君主蛇
content_en:
Let Vine Snake go aside to practice the dual forms of the grass blender... Lin Feng took out the stool from the storage ball, picked up his phone and started browsing.He is not being lazy, but is looking for a vendor to buy plants.Lin Feng will save the few harvests from the plantation and use them with other peach and orange fruits this year to make detoxification energy cubes and physical energy cubes.This is easy to store and can also be used as a commodity in the nursery.Give some more to Grandpa Qin.The rest will be sold.As for the channels...Lin Feng is not worried.Because my parents went to many places to purchase vegetables and crops.One of the most famous places is called Trumpet Ya Fruit and Vegetable Department Store, and now the name has turned into Da Shi Hua Food Co., Ltd.It seems that it has evolved over the past ten years.... "This is it...".... Dashihua Food Co., Ltd. - Boss' Office.Boss Chen Xiao has been a little worried recently. Dashihua Food Co., Ltd., which just went public, has encountered its first problem.That is the squeeze from "peers".To be precise.Not a peer, but a supermarket with only a slight edge.But...it's the largest company in Wutong City - Want Want Co., Ltd.When Dashihua was still a fruit and vegetable supermarket, the other party had a tendency to suppress it.This trend became blatant after Dashihua Food Co., Ltd. went public.First of all, there are huge price cuts in the food section of fruits and vegetables in supermarkets.Then intercept their delivery channels at a high price from the source.In this way, the various fruit and vegetable markets and supermarkets under the company cannot sell things, and at the same time, fresh food raw materials cannot be collected.If things go on like this, the company will go bankrupt sooner or later.Therefore, the problem now is that we urgently need a stable supplier."What's wrong? Are you still having a headache about the supermarket?" Just as he was holding his forehead,

A beautiful woman wearing a yellow patterned skirt walked in from outside. The woman was plump and graceful, with a ponytail and a gorgeous appearance.Chen Xiao sighed, looked at his wife in front of him, shook his head, and finally said nothing.An old man, a young wife, and a daughter who is in high school.Now is the time when energy needs to be expended. He is only in his forties and has already lost a lot of hair."There is no way. The suppression of Want Want Supermarket is too severe. Without supply channels, the company may be suppressed as soon as it goes public." In the end, Chen Xiao did not hide the situation from his wife."Then let's go back to the small supermarket. Yue'er's Pokémon doesn't have to be a quasi-god. We can just pick a very good Yusanjia." "If you choose a quasi-god Pokémon, you will need a lot of money to train it. If something happens in the future and you can't train it, the quasi-god Pokémon will be ruined..." The woman looked at her husband who was full of melancholy and couldn't help but persuade."That's what I said...but the child..." After finishing his words, Chen Xiao sighed again.They are a large chain company across the country, but they are just a small industry in Wutong Town. How can they be comparable to them in terms of capital chain?The only possible way to win is to outperform the other party's fruits and vegetables in terms of quality.It is also necessary to crush the other party.But... if you want to grow such fruits and vegetables, it means that you must at least have a breeder.He must also be a cultivator who specializes in planting.But breeders are already scarce, let alone breeders who specialize in planting."Hey...if it doesn't work..." He really felt that he was overthinking it and was about to give up.The landline phone on the table suddenly rang."Loto, the purchasing department is calling, do you want to answer the call?" "Purchasing department?" Chen Xiao was stunned, and then he immediately picked up the Rotom phone, "It's me, what's wrong?" "Huh? Is there a new supply channel? The sample looks good? In... Okay, I understand." He put down the phone. Although he had just heard that there was a new supply channel, his expression still did not improve."What's wrong? Didn't you say that there is a new supply channel? Isn't this something that we should be happy about?" The wife next to her couldn't help but asked when she saw that her husband was not happy.Chen Xiao smiled bitterly and said: "There are new supply channels, but it is the plantation in Wutong Town. As you know, that plantation used to belong to the old Lin family. Now I heard that it was taken over by his children..." "Think about it, how many things can a child grow? Moreover, the quality is still good.It’s not necessarily good.”The wife said with some surprise: “That kid Xiaofeng?He doesn’t go to high school and inherits the family plantation?”If you like Pokémon: A Menus and a Monarch Snake at the beginning, please collect: (aiquwx) Pokémon: A Menus and a Monarch Snake at the beginning.
